description: Post-confirmation diagnostic of the task-to-meta type adapter. Fixed before these new outcomes. This is not the original primary confirmation.
notes: Only the meta-level type mapping changes. Circuit task semantics, features, grammar, seed, evaluator and budgets stay fixed.
Every permutation is reported, not only the best.
The uniform seed-author behavior is invariant to all type permutations; software tests verify complete fixed-author trajectories pointwise.
Six recursive adapter variants share tasks and random streams with one common fixed-author run per seed. Each method's resource cost is still charged separately.
Primary diagnostic effects compare each nonidentity recursive adapter with the identity recursive adapter, with J=15 simultaneous finite-sample empirical Bernstein intervals.
Recursive-minus-fixed effects across six adapters and three families use a separate J=18 confidence family.
No claim that a type permutation is a semantics-preserving change to the complete self-modifying system; the change is a declared causal intervention.
